It means around 2 hour we spend in going and coming.Due to some class sometimes we are unable to join juma due to this 2 hour time.We have musalla in our university where we pray atleast zohar asar maghrib sometimes esha.We are planning to arrange Juma pray in our Musalla. Is it allowed in the light of Quran and Hadess (sunnat) ? And it should be noted that we do not have any permanent population of muslim here.All of us are student.JazakAllah Khair. Question: Salam Alaikum, Mufti sahab, I am in South Korea for study.In my University there are around 50 Muslims from different countries and with different Mazhab.For Juma Pray We go to a mosque which takes 40 to 50 minute. It means around 2 hour we spend in going and coming.Due to some class sometimes we are unable to join juma due to this 2 hour time.We have musalla in our university where we pray atleast zohar asar maghrib sometimes esha.We are planning to arrange Juma pray in our Musalla. Is it allowed in the light of Quran and Hadess (sunnat) ? And it should be noted that we do not have any permanent population of muslim here.All of us are student.JazakAllah Khair. Answer ID: 12776 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 781/734=B/1430) If your university is located in the suburbs of the city i.e. it is situated at less than 300 feet from the city, you can perform the Jumu?ah Salah in the university?s musalla. If the university is away from the city in fields with no settlements, you should continue to perform the Jumu?ah in the mosque where you perform regularly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
